RIGHT THROUGH THE GATE SHE GOES! INDIA OPEN THEIR WICKET ACCOUNT IN STYLE! Sayali Satghare bowling to Georgia Voll, good length ball, pitching outside off stump, the in-swinger goes right past Voll's defence, hits the top of leg stump. WICKET Georgia Voll b Sayali Satghare (Australia (Women) 2 Runs for 1 wickets)
